generator_variance_notes: Typography weight and line breaking varied across generations despite the locked type mode.
The same palette and morphology produced different atmospheric emphasis, but the layout relationships remained recognizable.
Support-copy legibility was weakest on the diagonal vector case, without becoming a hard failure.
